notes: Small feasibility trial, not a novelty or architecture claim.
Frozen IT backbone; existing conda base. No new environment or package installation.
Same ordered microbatches, answer tokens and optimized steps for all modes.
No test-based hyperparameter selection; evaluate final checkpoint only.
No dependency labels, hidden future information or oracle summaries are fed to controllers.
Seed and entity namespaces are disjoint across train/validation/test.
Only three-digit answer and newline tokens receive supervised loss.

Full-direction variant: add only GDN key channels before native depthwise convolution; preserve query/value channels and native L2 normalization. All five modes use matched approximately 0.69M parameter budgets.
Mechanism control: train and evaluate with the same token-position policy, rather than disabling branches only after training.
Ordinary local low-rank adapter; identical seed, examples, steps, learning rate and parameter count to the all-token local checkpoint.
Ledger-only can alter both recurrent states and KV construction. Question-only preserves all pre-question computation. Neither is a GDN-only intervention.
